messages:
anna: Heads up — scheduling a blue/green ribbon shift for gateway-router tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: shadow -> 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Pin traffic to v3.4.1-release for green.

mike: thanks. preflight checklist status? canary probes, warm caches, smoke tests?

sre-oncall: Canary health checks are green in staging. p95 latency threshold: 320ms, error budget alarm at 0.8%. Auto-rollback if >2 consecutive 5m windows breach.

leah: @pm-raj I updated release notes and the customer-facing changelog: small routing change, no customer-visible API changes.

pm-raj: ack. change window is 23:00-00:30 UTC, included in status page.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout: gateway-router v3.4.1-release -> green cluster. step=shadow, traffic=0%

anna: step1 done — shadow warmed for 10m, KV cache hit ~78%. moving to 5% in 2m.

mike: when you shift to 5% please hold for two successful 10m windows. I’ll watch traces and errors.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic shifted -> 5% ; step=canary1 ; monitor=true

sre-oncall: observed a small spike in 302s at 5% for one minute (svc: auth-proxy). Flaky backend - not end-to-end errors. Investigating logs.

mike: can we mute non-actionable 302s from health-checker? otherwise let's not conflate metrics.

sre-oncall: added filter for health-checker agent, re-evaluating. after filter p95 = 290ms, error rate = 0.12%. good to continue.

anna: proceeding to 25% in 3m. reminder: rollback gate = manual if any user-facing 5xx >0.5% for two successive windows. auto-rollback for latency breach per earlier.

leah: ops note — LB session-affinity sticky ttl will remain at 10m. no change expected.

pm-raj: customers on dedicated-tier in eu-west are pinned to legacy route; double-check no cross-traffic.

mike: verified — routing policy excludes dedicated-tier.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic shifted -> 25% ; step=canary2 ; monitor=true

sre-oncall: metrics look stable at 25% for 15m. memory and cpu on green nodes nominal.

anna: moving to 60% now. if everything stays green for 20m we finish to 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic shifted -> 60% ; step=bulk ; monitor=true

sre-oncall: small tail-latency bump on a subset of pods (node-pool-b). spinning extra warmers and rerouting a few pods. p95 back to baseline within 4m.

mike: good call to spin extra warmers. note: if tail > 400ms across region, we abort and drain green back to 0.

anna: final 100% in 10m if no regressions. cascade drain plan ready if rollback: 1) stop new traffic to green, 2) shift to blue 30s drip, 3) scale down green, 4) revert pin.

leah: tagging internal release notes with rollback steps and owner list.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: final shift -> 100% ; step=complete ; status=success

pm-raj: great work. adding brief postmortem checklist to the release thread: check customer metrics, billing delta, and latency dashboards tomorrow morning.

mike: thumbs up. I’ll open a follow-up for perf tuning if we see any residual tail. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: all good on my side. leaving services in auto-scale normal policy.

anna: closing the window early notes: release pinned version: v3.4.1-release; rollout duration = 30m; no rollback triggered. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
